title: Donald Macintyre
gist: A Prospect contributor index page for Donald Macintyre, author of “Gaza: Preparing for Dawn”, whose nine listed pieces track Israel/Palestine from on-the-ground West Bank reporting to the collapse of two-state hopes and the political cost to Joe Biden of backing Israel's Gaza campaign.

insights.claim: The correspondent's West Bank dispatch is headlined with Palestinians saying “They want us out of Palestine”, framing displacement rather than security as the organising story of the territory.
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine
insights.so_what: Displacement framing is becoming the dominant Western press lens on the West Bank, which precedes sanctions and diplomatic pressure.
insights.quote: ‘They want us out of Palestine’: On the ground in the West Bank

insights.claim: Hope for a two-state solution is described as dying, with a dedicated piece titled “Why hope of a two state solution is dying” and another asking who will lead Israel and Palestine to peace.
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine
insights.so_what: If the two-state frame collapses in mainstream commentary, diplomatic and sanctions risk around Israel repricing follows.
insights.locator: Why hope of a two state solution is dying

insights.claim: Joe Biden's unwavering support for Israel's Gaza onslaught is flagged as something that could come back to haunt him, published as a standalone argument.
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine
insights.so_what: Frames US domestic political blowback from Israel policy as a durable factor in American politics.
insights.quote: Joe Biden’s unwavering support for Israel’s Gaza onslaught could come back to haunt him
